description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single-target Ice/Water/Lightning/NE magical attacks (? each) capped at 19999, grants either [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Attach Water with Stacking], or [Attach Lightning with Stacking], grants [Damage Cap +10000] & Crystal Force Mode: Lulu to the user
Crystal Force Mode: Lulu: Ice/Water/Lightning Ability Boost, Dualcast Ice/Water/Lightning, Zero Hone Cost to Ice/Water/Lightning Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I: Instant cast single-target Ice/Water/Lightning/NE magic attack (?) at True Cap Break Level 1, [Magic Damage +30% 1] for 1 turn to party; Crystal Force II: Grants [Instant Cast 1], [Quick ATB 1] & [50% DEF/RES Pierce 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
